claims.claim_text_normalized: R-CNN achieves a mean average precision of 53.7% on PASCAL VOC 2010.
claims.evidence_quote_short: R-CNN achieves a mean average precision (mAP) of 53.7% on PASCAL VOC 2010.

claims.claim_text_normalized: R-CNN significantly outperforms OverFeat on the ILSVRC2013 detection dataset with a mAP of 31.4% versus 24.3%.
claims.evidence_quote_short: R-CNN significantly outperforms OverFeat, with a mAP of 31.4% versus 24.3%.

claims.claim_text_normalized: Supervised pre-training on a large auxiliary dataset followed by domain-specific fine-tuning yields a significant performance boost when labeled training data is scarce.
claims.evidence_quote_short: supervised pre-training on a large auxiliary dataset (ILSVRC), followed by domain-specific fine-tuning on a small dataset (PASCAL), is an effective paradigm for learning high-capacity CNNs when data is scarce.

claims.claim_text_normalized: Fine-tuning for detection improves mAP performance by 8 percentage points.
claims.evidence_quote_short: fine-tuning for detection improves mAP performance by 8 percentage points.

claims.claim_text_normalized: A simple bounding-box regression method significantly reduces mislocalizations, which are the dominant error mode.
claims.evidence_quote_short: a simple bounding-box regression method significantly reduces mislocalizations, which are the dominant error mode.

claims.claim_text_normalized: Features from fc7 generalize worse than features from fc6 without fine-tuning.
claims.evidence_quote_short: features from fc7 generalize worse than features from fc6.

claims.claim_text_normalized: R-CNN with the O-Net architecture substantially outperforms R-CNN with T-Net, increasing mAP from 58.5% to 66.0%.
claims.evidence_quote_short: R-CNN with O-Net substantially outperforms R-CNN with T-Net, increasing mAP from 58.5% to 66.0%.

claims.claim_text_normalized: The forward pass of O-Net takes roughly 7 times longer than T-Net.
claims.evidence_quote_short: the forward pass of O-Net taking roughly 7 times longer than T-Net.
